title: Crazy Man Pulls Gun On Tow Truck Driver After Trying To Repo His Car
description:
#news #police #arrest

On September 21, 2022. Officers responded to a hostile situation in progress in regard to a man who was identified as "Henry" who pulled a gun on a tow truck driver as he was trying to tow his car away. "Henry" claimed the man was trying to "steal" the car.  He was charged with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, armed burglary, resisting without violence and improper exhibition of a fireman.
